resources.string: This JSON export is not encrypted. Anyone with access to the saved file can read it. Choose a trusted location.
Export saved to the location you chose.

When enabled, LUMA sends the text you choose and only the relevant local context needed for that action to the Google Gemini API. Your API key remains encrypted on this device. Gemini cannot change, schedule, delete, or send your data without confirmation. Switching back to Local only revokes this consent.
Off by default. When enabled, LUMA stores short correction patterns and explicit learning records on this device. These records are not included in export.
This deletes local AI suggestion history, corrections, learned rules, and saved learning records. Notes, tasks, reminders, captures, Spaces, and settings stay.
Learned data could not be cleared. Existing data was kept.
Off by default. When enabled, a small relevant preference profile may be included in optional Gemini requests.
